items.summary: Harry Kane orchestrated Bayern's fightback against Arsenal in a thrilling 2-2 Champions League draw, scoring from the penalty spot and assisting Alphonso Davies, though the team ultimately conceded a late equalizer to Declan Rice.

source.title: 'We should've killed it off' – Kane rues Bayern's missed chances in Arsenal draw

items.summary: Kane became only the second player in history to score in 10 consecutive Champions League appearances, joining Cristiano Ronaldo, while also netting his 16th career goal against Arsenal.

source.title: Bayern Munich 2-2 Arsenal: Rice salvages late draw to deny Kane winner

items.summary: Vincent Kompany's side faced Arsenal without key creators Michael Olise (suspended) and Jamal Musiala (injured), contributing to their second consecutive European draw after a 3-3 stalemate with Viking last week.

source.title: Bayern Munich vs. Arsenal Player Ratings: Rice Saves Gunners From Rare European Defeat
